tei:div.tei:p: (1na1)༄༅// rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa che long tsam brjod pa grub pa'i rol rtsed ces bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba2)rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi mgon po'i rnam thar che long tsam brjod pa grub pa'i rol rtsed ces bya ba/ rdo rje 'dzin pa de nyid kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// shes bya kun gzigs mig po che des 'khor ba'i pha mtha' bcad byas shing*/ tshad med thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzang pos zhi ba'i sa la tshur drangs pas/ bsam yas 'phrin las mdzad pa'i stobs shugs nam mkha' ji srid mi chad pa'i/ dpal ldan grub pa mchog gi 'byon khungs sa la 'brug pa'i bka' brgyud do// gang gi chos kyi gdangs mchog gis/ kun gyi spyi bo'i mgon 'os po/ 'jam legs mandha ra yi dpal/ dad ldan mtho ris tshal du 'khrungs/ e ma mthu stobs kyis khengs pa/ gzhan sde dpung pa pad sna la ltar/ phra byed 'di ka sa gzhi la/ rdo rje 'dzin 'ongs min na su/ yang dag lam la dga' ba'i bshes/ phan bde kun gyi gnyen bzang po/ gang la bstod nas de'i ngo mtshar/ mos pas bzod tsam 'dir bsnyad do// yon gnas dam pa rnams ni rang gi yon tan ji lta ba gzhan gyi ngor mngon sum du 'byin par mi mdzad cing*/ ji tsam gyi gdul bya mos shing mgu bar 'gyur ba de tsam zhig de dag la ston no zhes thos kyi/ dpal 'brug pa'i 'phrin las kyi ba dan sa gsum du skyong ba mthu stobs kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'di yang de lta bas na/ de'i spyod pa'i tshul mdo tsam gleng ngo*// de yang*/ dpal lha mo re ma tis/ 'di ni bla ma chen po bsam rgyal kha che (2na3)zhes pa yar 'brog stag lung gi phur bon yar me ba zhes pa'i gdan sa de kha'i sprul par grags pa sgrub bon mkhas la mthu che ba zhig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad nas/ ra lung pa'i chos rje 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge'i zhabs la gtugs pas bka' gsar ma'i man ngag gi glegs bam chen po/ dpal 'brug pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la chos dpa' ba/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang mi dang mi lab pa lta bur mdzad pa mthu stobs kyi gar bu zhig go// de nas skye ba bdun pa 'di'i bar du chos skyong chen po des mngon sum du rjes su gzung ba sha stag yin pas/

'di'i nus pa gzhan gyis bzod par dka'o zhes bdag gi yongs su 'dzin pa dpal 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan sngar lung bstan pa'i dus/ rje bla mas kyang de de bzhin no zhes bsngags pas/ 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir yid ches pa thams cad kyi rtse mo'o// skye dang skye bar dam pa'i mgon rnyed pas/ phul phyin spyangs pa byas te mthar 'byin la/ srid mtshor dad pa'i rgyal po rnams bzhin du/ 'jug par spro 'di yon tan la sred pa/ 'dir srid ji ltar gzung ba'i tshul ni/ lho phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams chos kyi rgyal po bya ba nang so'i chib 'og /dpal tsa ri tra'am hi ma la ya/ sngon gyi lo tsa ba sa yi ge bsnan te lha'i gangs ldan zhes bsgyur ba yul chen po nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gya ba de'i lho sgo/ mdo sde phal po che nas/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs bzhugs pa'i gnas be'ur zhes par klus bskrun pa'i thub pa 'byung ngo zhes gsal bar lung bstan pa be'u kha la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang du ma gnas pa/ spyir byar zhes pa/ gangs dang sman gyi ri ljongs nyams dga' ba nags tshal gyi 'phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyugs dang phyugs lhas kyis ri bo'i sul gang ba/ 'byor ldan gyi grong bkod legs su sbrengs pa (2ba4)bza' shing gi ra bas khyab pa/ 'dod dgu'i zong 'grim pa'i lam srang yangs po/ dga' ba'i longs spyod kyis skyid pa'i gnas su byas pa/ bye brag skyid phug ces chos kyi rgyal po gtsang pa rgya ras pas zhabs kyi padmo bkod pa'i sgrub gnas/ ming ji lta ba dben zhing nyams dga' ba/ bkra shis pa g.yang chags pa'i mnga' zhes steng zhes bya ba'i sa'i char ro// gangs ldan ri bo'i khor yug dogs dang sul/ sman ljongs nags klung lha yi tshal lta bu/ phun tshogs 'byor pa 'dzom pa'i yul de yang*/ bsod nams las kyi 'du byed kho nas bsgrubs/ yul der rnam thos bu'i 'byor pa la 'gran bzod pa/

gtong phod che la 'dzangs shing yid gzhungs pas chos kyi rgyal po de'i drung 'khor dra mar gtogs pa'i khyim bdag legs pa dbang phyug /rong ston chen po'i rgyal tshab dgas po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ karma 'phrin las par grags pa gnyis kyi dbon mo skyer mo dpal sgron zhes bya ba'i sras su sring lnga'i thu bor byon te lhums su zhugs pa'i dus yum la bu mo rgyan gos bzang pos sprad pa mang pos lha'i phyag mtshan du ma sprod pa tshags byas pa'i rmi lam byung*/ de nas dgung lo nyer ba na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs nyi 'og lho'i phyogs de pa'i gong ma chen por 'khrungs pa/ dpal nā ro pa'i sprul pa'i sku 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos kyi grags pa yul der byon pa mjal/ de ni/ sngon rabs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen por gyur pas/ zhal mjal ba'i mod lam mdun du rgyug pa lta bur dga' la/ rje'i brtse ba'i gzigs pa'ang 'di'i phyogs su lhung nas/ phal bu 'di la gces spras su gyis shig ces dang*/ lhag par chos skyong la bka' bsgo mdzad de bar chad las bsrungs so// bcu gsum pa la phya ba'i slob ma gnyal pa rin chen seng ger grags pa de'i dgon pa khar po go yul du/ bla ma rnam grol bzhes pa cig la klog yig bslabs/ bcu bdun pa la chos kyi rgyal po'i phyag phyi zhus/ mchod bshom pa'i las tshan gzung*/ ngang tshul (3na5)'jam dang ngul bas kun smon par byas/ de yang 'di skad du/ padma'i mtsho las 'dab brgya'i 'phreng ba dang*/ legs byas smin dor skyes bu'i myu gu 'di// sa la legs bshad zil dngar zhim po'i tshogs/ mi zad spel ba'i dpyid kyi pho nyar byung*// nges legs dpal gyi dga' char myur 'bab snyam/ rigs sad ngo mtshar chu skyes kun 'dzum pa'i// bsngags 'os dri bzang kun gyi gter brdol bas// dpyod ldan yid kyi bung ba brel bar byas/ nyer gcig pa'i dus su// rje de'i zhal snga nas khyod skye ba mang por ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pas rjes su gzung zhing dngos grub sgrub pa'i skal ba can yin pas rab tu byung zhig ces bka' stsal pa ltar de nyid kyi drung du skra phud phul/

chos kyi mgon po 'jam dpal rdo rje dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du mtshan gsol/ dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa nas/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi rdzogs dang*/ chos skyong phyag bzhi pa'i dbang*/ rjes gnang sogs bstsal nas/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa gsol btab ste/ dus thog de la rig sngags 'chang ba la 'gran zla med pa/ gsang sngags gsar rnying thams cad kyi man ngag gi bum pa/ drag sngags kyi tshogs thams cad kyis thugs kyi dbang po brtas pa/ mi'i dbang phyug ne'u sku bsrung ba rgyal mtshan lhun grub/ yul gtsang phyogs na bla ma kong chung du grags pa/ rgyal dbang rje'i zhal slob de la/ rjes 'di la rdo rje nag po chen po phyag bzhi pa gtso bor byas pa'i chos skyong thams cad kyi rgyud sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa dpyis phyin par slobs shig /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan thogs chen po'i byung nges so// zhes gsungs te sbyor gtod mdzad/ mthu chen des kyang sras dad mi phyed pa'i brtse bas bskyangs te/ tsa mi dang rga lo/ steng pa lo tsha ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ ro lings lo tsa ba rdo rje dbang phyug /khe rgad 'khor lo grags sogs kyis (3ba6)bsgyur ba'i chos skyong phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub skor/ 'brug pa rnams kyi bya rog ma bstan bsrungs kyi skor du grags pa de'i khrod du pha gru dang tshal pa sogs kyi lugs kun snang ba/ gter mgon du grags pa mnga' bdag chen po myang ral pa can gyi man ngag kun dang*/ dpal lha mo/ gri gug rje blon drang srong gza'/ zhing skyong sogs chos skyong la bka' gter gyi yig rigs ci mchis pa dpe mkhyud med par bstsal zhing gzhan yang rnying ma'i gsang sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan zhing*/ bla ma dam pa de'i chos skyong gi bka' babs kyang 'di yin no// gsung che la nyan pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs lta bus kun gyi yid phrogs/

mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong dri bzang la bung ba lta bur rgyun du 'khor ba'i mtshan ma yang rtser/ nyid kyi sku'i zhang po yang rtse'i 'chad nyan du bzhugs pa de sogs dang khang bu gcig na mang po stabs su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nyid kyi dbu sngas su dpal lha mo dud pa'i sol ba ma'i sgrub thabs kyi yi ge slob dpon zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa sogs de nyid kyis mngon sum du bskyal byung bkun sus bskyal lam zhes dogs pa na/ de ni lha mo nyid kyis rjes su gzung ba yin pas de dag gi brgyud pa gzhan la ltos mi dgos so zhes rje rdo rje gling pa gsung ngo*// rje gong ma de nyid kyi drung du/ bde mchog gi rgyud bshad lho ya yag pa'i 'grel chen steng nas gsan/ dgyes rdor rin chen rgyan 'dra'i steng nas gsan/ chos skyong gi skor dang*/ lhag pa na ras chung snyan rgyud dam mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud du grags pa yab bka' bzhi/ yum bka' gsum/ grol lam chos drug /'og sgo/ phyag chen/ bar do/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor du grags pa'i cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs par dang*/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid la sogs pa man ngag gsan/ rje de nyid kyi bshad pa'i bka' 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gling pa yon tan ye shes dpal bzang po las kyi rdo rje gsum par grags pa de'i zhabs pad bsten te dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la (4na7)sogs pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag /sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs la sogs pa'i gsar rnying gi dbang chos mang du gsan/ yang sgrub pa'i bka' babs pa/ rgyal sras mi tra dzo kir lha dang bla mas lung bstan pa'i kun spangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ mtshan gzhan sgyu ma'i gar mkhan zhes pa de la/ gsang 'dus rim lnga/ ro snyoms sogs rje chos kyi grags pa nas brgyud pa'i snyan rgyud kyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ de nas rje gong ma sprul pa'i snang brnyan bsdus pa la thugs skyo ba dang*/

yul phyogs der grub mtha'i kun slong gis thugs sun nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la gtsang du byon/ kun nas grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po ra lung thel zhes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bye ba snyed sangs rgyas pa'i rdo rje gdan chen por/ dpal 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis sgra bsgyur gyi dbang po mar pa lo tsa'i sprul pa'i skur bsgrags pa/ mkhyen rab dang thugs rje nus pa rgyal ba thams cad dang gnyis su ma mchis pas mtha' dpog pa'i rtsom pa dang bral ba de lo gsum gyi ring gdan sa de nyid du sku mtshams la bzhugs par dam bcas pa'i lo gcig song ba tsam la zhabs kyi padmo bsten par mdzad de/ sku mtshams stabs kyis zhal ma mjal kyang dgon khang gsar pa chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa'ang zhabs phyir 'byor ba sogs kyi gsung chos ches smar ba byung*/ bcad rgya de yangs su song nas zhal mjal dgyes dgyes mdzad/ sku dang 'bral med du bzhugs/ gsung chos kyang phyag rgya chen po skor gsum du grags pa rgyud sde rin po che thams cad kyi don 'byed pa'i lde mig tshan po'i glegs bam/ lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i skor/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i skor gyi chos sde/ bsre 'pho gnad kyi mtshams sbyor du grags pa dgas po bka' brgyud parnams kyi gzhung lam chen po/ 'byung ba ro snyoms (4ba8)skor drug /khrid chen brgyad/ thub pa lnga/ ri chos skor gsum/ dge sbyor bdun pa la sogs pa'i zab khrid 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud/ bcu gsum ma'i dbang lung*/ phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud/ man ngag gi glegs bam/ phag mo bden gnyis zhal gyi chos skor/ chos skyong gi rgyud sgrub skor sogs 'brug pa'i sgrub thabs skor lnga dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa/ thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/

grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dpag med lha mangs sogs 'phral dgos kyi sgrub thabs bzhi/ rje dgas po rin po che'i chos bzhir grags pa ngo bo jo bo chen po a ti sha'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa phag gru lugs sogs dang*/ sgrub pa'i thabs rgya mtsho zhes pa slob dpon chen po a bha ya ka ra guptas glegs bam du bsgrigs pa'i lung ces gnang sogs dang*/ bka' brgyud ser 'phreng mar mi dgas po/ phag gru/ gling*/ chos rje rgya ras/ lo rgod/ seng ge dgu tshar rnams kyi bka' 'bum/ bla ma zhang rin po che'i bka' rgya ma logs zab chos bka' bod tshang ma/ stag lung thang pa snga phyi'i bka' 'bum/ de nas brgyud pa'i chos skyong phyag bzhi pa'i gser pod sogs dbang rgyud lung man ngag thams cad kyis blo gros kyi bum pa gang bar mdzad/ de nyid kyi sras khri thog pa ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ces pa phyag na rdo rje'i grub thob tu grags pa der yang phyag rdor sogs dbang lung*/ de'i gcung rgyal tshab dam pa ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por sher phyin gyi mdo rgyas 'bring bsdus pa la sogs pa'i lung*/ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ rje padma dkar po la'ang rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang lung sogs 'ga' zhig gsan/ gzhan chos rje lces pa'am g.yul rgyal bar grags pa la phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa'i chos skor/ chos rje ngag dbang lhun grub pa dang*/ chos rje sangs rgyas bzang po la sogs par yang man ngag du ma dang*/ phyi (5na9)mar ti pu'i bzhi chos sogs dang*/ spyod pa sangs rgyas dpal gyi khri brgya sogs man ngag mang po dang*/ rdzas sna chos rje ngag dbang bzang po la phyag bzhi pa'i yongs grags kyi rgyud nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs 'brug lugs kyi man ngag sdar ma gsan pa'i yig phran 'ga' dang*/ rje khrus khang lo tsa ba la paṇḍi ta nags kyi rin po ches bstsal ba'i sbyor drug rgyas bsdus/

lce rtse rkan sbyar/ padma tshe khrid/ birwa pa'i tshe khrid sogs dang*/ gling stod pa grags pa bshes gnyen la/ rje gong ma nas brgyud pa'i man ngag 'ga' dang*/ nyid kyi sku zhang chos grags bstan pa rab 'phel bar yang rnam 'joms mthing kha sogs 'ga' zhig gsan pas/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i zab rgyas kyi gdams ngag ma tshang ba med pa/ phyag len gtsang la nges pa rgya che bas thams cad kyi dpang du gyur pa/ tshad mar gyur pa yin no// gzhan yang*/ spyan snga rin po che zhwa dmar ba chen po chos kyi grags pa la chos 'brel tsam dang*/ sa skya bdag chen dag pa'i drung na lind+rar bzhugs pa dang rje thugs nye bas sku 'khor chos gsan pa la phar gnang tshur gnang ba'i khrod du phebs nas rjes gnang 'ga' gsan pa dang*/ rgyal dbang karma mi bskyod rdo rje kong po sa phur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje kong por phebs/ de'i tshe rje'i phyag phyi nas cog grwa dge 'dun drug brgya tsam karma pa mjal du byon pa'i khyur bzhugs pas thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas dang*/ rje stag lung du phebs dus/ a thang pa chen po chos rje rnam rgyal grags pa khu dbon la gsung chos dang*/ 'bri khung rin po che rin chen phun tshogs zhes pa bka' gsar rnying gi bdag po de la thugs dad pas chos 'brel dang*/ dus phyis byon gyi skad gnyis smra ba thams cad kyi dbang phyug zhwa lu lo chen mtshan dharma pā lar grags pa de la tshe mdo la sogs pa gsan/ rje kong por phebs dus 'brug chos sdings su bka' las/ lha mo re ma tis 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa'i sprul pa'i sku mdo khams stod du 'khrungs (5ba10)ces lung bstan pas/ sngar gangs dkar mo ba brdzangs pa yin te ma rnyed/ da rung khyod kyis tshol shog ces kong po me rag mdo nas rdzong dar mdzad/ rje dpon slob yar phebs/ de dus mnal lam du bud med bzang po zhig gis/ sprul sku 'di na yod/ ne nas mar phyin shan 'dra zer/

phan tshun gnyis pa'i grong 'bru re rags yod pa zhig na bu chung ral pa sib sib yod pa zhig bstan byung*/ phyis dgon dbang ra ji lta bar 'dug gsung ngo*// de nas spo bo brgyud khams stod hram pa la byon/ de dus rgya ston chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan par rgya ston bka' 'bum sogs dang*/ zur mang sku skye blo gros rgya mtsho ba la ratna gling pa'i bla ma thugs sgrub kyi skor yongs su rdzogs pa dang gcod yul gsan/ ri bo cher stag lung ngag dbang grags pa'i sku'i skye bar grags pa de dang mjal bdag rkyen gzab par byung*/ de nas rjes yar shog /sprul sku de phyogs na yod shas cung bar 'dug gsung 'bod mi gnang yar phebs/ phyis sprul pa'i sku padma dkar po bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i phyag phyir/ dpal 'khor bde chen zhes pa mkhas mang 'du ba'i mdun sa/ longs spyod kyi rgya mtsho/ myang lung pa'i bde skyid kyi 'byung khung chos kyi rgyal po rgyal mkhar rtse ba'i bla'i grwa'i mkhan po bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i drung*/ slob dpon tshogs chos lung pa'i mkhan po dkon mchog mtshan mi spyir khrom yon du grags pa 'dzin tshugs legs pa'i dpe/ gsang ston rtse chen mkhan po sangs rgyas ye shes sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu phrag gi dbus su bsnyen pa rdzogs pa nas 'dul ba'i bcas pa lnga mig lta bu'i gces spras su mdzad cing*/ lar yang sngags pa yin zhal bga' chal du sbyon pa nam yang mdzad ma myong*/ rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs pa'i dus na'ang gzhan gyi dge slong las tshugs dam pa zhig go// phyis rdor 'dzin mdzad nas tsa ri trar chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes chos kyi rje bstan (6na11)pa rgya mtsho'i dbon dam pa de spyan drangs/ gsar rnying gi rgyud 'bum gyi lung gsan/ phar yang gsung chos mang du phul/ yang skyid shod du dpon sa stag lung mas spyan drangs pa'i dus su tshal yang dgon pa'i chos rjer/

bla ma zhang gi bka' brgya'i khrid lung dbang*/ chos skyong tshal lugs sngar ma gsan pa 'ga' gsan/ khong la 'brug skor phar gnang*/ gzhan yang grags can dang ku sa la'i bla ma ci yang zhig bsten nas thos pa'i rgya mtsho bskyil bas tha ri 'dod rnams kyi re ba'i man ngag rin po che 'dzad pa med par 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur to/ gang yang gsan pa tsam la mi 'jog par de dag gi lag len mthil phyin pa bslabs/ dogs dpyod kyi rus la thebs par mdzad pas dgu lo brgyad cur nye ba 'di na'ang chos gar yin pa de'i dmigs pa phyag len bshad pa'i tshig ris phran bu tshun yang bsnyel ba med par seng nge ye re/ bkra hrig hrig ston pa 'di byung ba yin/ zhu mi'i mdun min pa gang du yang mi mkhyen par brdzus te bzhugs/ ngom ngom yer mer mi mdzad/ gdams ngag la nges pa'i dbang gis rje'i drung du/ rin po che glo bo mtshan snyan par grags pa kun dga' sgrol mchog phebs pa'i dus su'ang dogs dpyod kyi yul du mdzad/ rje de dang bdag mjal ba'i dus su'ang nyid la grogs po gzhan dang mi 'dra gsung mnyes mnyes rang mdzad kyi 'dug /de dus la de la chos 'brel zhig kyang gsan par 'dug cig /phyis ze bo ma 'gas rjed pa gam par mjal dus gnas tshul rtsad gcod mdzad shin tu mnyes khong la sku tshe [WP:76,57]ིnga po yong ba yod zhus gsung ngo*// chos rje tshar chen zhes pa sa skya pa'i nang nas sngags 'chang gi tog tu 'thon pa de rje'i drung du chos skyong skor gsan par phebs pa'i dus su'ang dka' gnas kyi dri sa mdzad pas thugs ches pa 'ba' zhig yin pas/ gdams ngag sad su da re shes pa'ang mis mtshor dogs pa dang*/ 'ga' shas shes pa'i nga rgyal gyi sgang bu can rnams dang mi 'dra bar/ mkhyen pa rgya che (6ba12)thugs chung bas na phyi rabs rnams kyi mig ltos bya sa'o// 'dzam gling kun na rgyu ba'i legs bshad klung*// gang du zhugs pa'i blo gros chu gter mtha'// sus dpag ma nus gangs can mtsho nyid ces// bsngags pa'i me tog thams cad de la spungs// kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i zhabs skyes thod lta bur// khur 'di snying dogs mun la sdod glags ci// bden rdzun grub pa 'di sogs bgrang yas kyi// gzhal byar byed 'dod pa la mngon gyur bstan// 'di'i drung na mtshams zla re zla gnyis byas de'i ring bsnyen pa/

khri 'bum tsam bskyal nas rtags 'di byung 'di ma byung gleng ba na/ gzhan mi gsung bar/ chos rje g.yul rgyal rdzong pa'i gsung nas/ ngas phyag na rdo rje la bsnyen pa bye ba phrag mang po bskyal te kha spu la me stag 'phro ba tsam las ma byung*/ khyed tsho bsnyen pa brgya re la grub rtags 'dod pa yi dam snying thag nye mos dgos 'dug gsung ba skyor/ de skad gsung ba thugs bden pa ste rang gis mtshan ma dam dum la ngoms te ma bzhag par nan tan je cher mdzad pas so// rje gong ma dpon slob la/ thog med bde mgon gyi dbang nos nas/ yang rtser/ bde mchog lhan skyes la bsnyen pa gsung ngag shin tu dam par mdzad dus/ rje des ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba zhig gsol 'phro bstsal ba tshang bar bzhes pa dang*/ sku 'khris na chos skyong gi bris pa thang legs pa'i tshad cig bdug pa kha phye ste gnang ba sogs byin rlabs 'byung ba'i mnal lam 'ga' byung*/ bsnyen grangs 'bum phrag bcu bzhi song ba'i tho rangs sa g.yos/ 'od kyis gzims spyil gyi nang khyab/ yi ge bdun pa sgrar grags pa dngos su byung*/ yang rjes/ chos rgyal gling gi tshoms su gtor sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe/ gter tshogs kyi steng du bya rog snum la che ba skad drag po sgrag pa dang*/ mkhar po go yul du zla ba drug tsam mgon po la bsnyen pa mdzad dus/ bud med mdzes ma mang pos dpal 'bras mang po stong pa/ ral gri bzang po gtad pa dang*/ ka pā la bza' ma tu ba (7na13)gis bkang ba gtad pa sogs dang*/ rje gong mas mtshan brjod kyi lung stsal te dpe'i bdag po khyod yin gsung gtad pa sogs mtshan lam bzang po dang*/ lo ro rdo rje gling tsan dan shug pa'i gseb kyi dgon gnas su/ rje rdo rje gling pas rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ sku bsrung pa chen pos rdo rje rgyal theb pa mdzad nas bka' brgyad kyi sgrub pa chen po btsugs pa gsan pa'i dus/ lding khri'i dbus na bka'a' dgu'i lha tshogs thams cad khra phud de bzhugs pa yud cig gzigs/

sku bsrung pa chen po la chos skyong gsan pi tshe yang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs gzigs shing*/ sta gon gyi mtshon mnal lam na/ mgon po'i rgyud gsar rnying gi be bum thams cad des gtad pa rmis pa dang*/ 'brug pa rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i drung du phyag na rdo rje'i dbang gsan dus/ rje de nyid gsang ba thams cad kyi bdag po 'khrul med du gzigs/ de nas gzung ste lha de'i bsnyen sgrub da lta'i bar du ma chag par mdzad/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i rtags brgyad tshang ba dang lha de nyid kyi 'khor lo mngon sum du mjal/ chos skyong gi bsnyen sgrub 'dra mdzad pa'i dus mgon po lcam dral/ las mgon sogs mngon sum du yud tsam re snang ba mang du byung*/ rje'i drung du phebs nas/ sku bsrung ba gyis ces gsungs pas/ phyis rten bzhengs ma grub kyi bar dgos gal che ba'i dmigs bsal re tsam ma gtogs sku 'khris pa dang mchod dpon rgyun bskang gsum sbrag mdzad/ gsung chos ci gnang la chud pas gsung gi gsang ba phal mo zin/ zhar byung dgos dpyod mdzad pas rje yang shin tu mnyes te/ sras gnyis sogs kyi phyag bzhes 'bul ba po bcol/ nang so thon pas sgrub sde btsugs/ nang so rang sogs 'brug lugs kyi cho ga lag len mthil phyin pa bslab bzhed de/ rje le sku drung na bzhugs pa'i gseb nas slob dpon zhus (7ba14)pas/ bka' las chos mgon pa 'di man ngag thob rgya che/ lag len thams cad la nged rang la lhag pa tsam yod/ khyad par bsnyen sgrub sogs mthar phyin chos skyong dngos kyis rjes su gzung ba zhig yin pas 'di 'jog /nad so rang gi bla ma'ang 'os pa yod ces gsungs pas/ nang sos de kha nas bla mar 'khur chos skyong gi skor thams cad gsan lag len bslab pa dang bstun lo tsam bzhugs/ de'i tshe lo gsar kha'i dgu gtor la/ sde pa rang nus can du brtsi ba'i sngags bon lhag par ri bo dge ldan pa'i dge bshes 'jigs byed dngos su brtsi ba cig sogs mang pos gtor ma brdeg par byon pas/

rlung nag 'tshubs te thams cad yar log /thugs rtog za ba na/ de khar sngags 'chang nyid dpon slob kyis dpal chen po rgwa lo'i slob ma cog ro'i lugs kyi gtor chen bsgrubs pa de 'phangs pas lhags pa mod la zon skyor bzhin byas/ yid la med par yal nas 'gyur bas gtor gral pa gzhan 'ga' rnga har khyer te gtor ma 'phang phyogs su brgyugs pa sogs byung bas thugs yid lhag par ches/ gus pa gzhan dang mi 'dra/ 'phral gyi phyag dpe sogs dgos pa thams cad kyi sbyin bdag mdzad pas shin tu mkho bar byung gsung ngo*// rgyun du'ang srod nas brtsams te blos bslang ba'i mnal ye mi gzims par bsnyen pa 'ba' zhig mdzad pa sang lto ran tshun bzhugs/ rje spyan drangs pa'i phyag phyir/ byang stag lung*/ gong dkar yar rgyab/ bsam yas/ 'khrang po/ chu shul/ smyug la/ thon/ yar shar nub sogs sde dpon chen po'i go kun tu phebs/ mchod g.yog pa mdzad pa'i gshis kyis mi chen kun dang thugs 'dris pa/ 'gro ba'i tshe gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad/ de'i zhor la/ lha sa'i jo shāka /tshal gung thang*/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa/ khra 'brug /byams gling sogs kyi rten mjal smon lam 'debs pa sogs mdzad/ skabs shig na rje'i zhal snga nas/ da lta tshe thung nad mang dus snyigs lha srin gdug pa che bas gnod pa dang 'tshe (8na15)ba mod pa'i dus su/ chos thos bsam gyi mtha' rgya gcod pa'i skabs ma yin/ bsgrub pa snying por byed dgos/ lhag par rang re'i brgyud pa 'di chos gcig shes pas kun shes pa yang byon pa yin/ gcig shes pa la 'di sgrub pa snying por gzung ba las byung bar 'dug pas/ khyed rang rnams kyang lo gsum gyi mtshams re 'brug se ba byang chub kyi gling 'dir gyis phebs pa dang*/ dus de'i tshe sku 'khor na bzhugs pa'i dge bshes/ rab 'byams pa dpal rin/ dharmā pa/ rin rdor sogs 'bras yul skyed tshal du grags thon pa gsum dang*/

sngags 'chang shākya dpal mgon zhes pa dpal 'khor bde chen/ zha lun yo ga sogs bu lugs kyi dbang phyug len la 'gran zla med par rtsi ba de dang*/ nyid la sogs pa 'ga' shas lo mtshams la rje nyid kyis mthun rkyen stsal te bzhugs so// gnas de rje gtsang pa rgya ras dpon slob kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ lhag par chos rje'i ljags bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel gyis dgon gnas 'di'i ming chos brgyud la thogs pas 'brug pa zhes byung ba de lta bu sogs ya mtshan la byin chags pa yin mod kyang*/ de sdang sgrub chen mangs/ bar zhig tu ma byung ba rgyun 'gyangs tsam song byas pa gnas rgod du gyur pa lta bu dang*/ lhag par mtshams bzhugs rnams kyang thugs dam gyi rtsal che bas bar chad thams cad dus gcig na longs nas/ 'ga' zhig la lha 'dre'i dmag gis mngon sum du bskor ba dang*/ byi la'i dmag dang*/ g.yo sgyu sna tshogs kyis bslu ba sogs byung*/ nyid la 'byung pos bug sgo brdung ba/ tshog chom gyi sgra thog sdib la khad pa/ shugs pa 'chor ba/ co ldir ba/ 'jigs pa'i gzugs du ma ston pa/ ri bar du 'tshir ba/ mes sreg pa dang*/ chur bskyur ga sas mnan pa dang*/ spre'u gzugs gdong dmar po dmag lta bur 'tshang ba sogs nyams dang rmi lam tsam shin par mngon sum rang la lan re lan gnyis min pa byung*/ lhag par sku'i gzugs bzhi'i khum pa grum bu lta bu'i gcong gis zin kyang*/ (8ba16)rkyen ngan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ nad sgrib pa'i phyags shing bar chad dngos grub kyi sna 'dren par dgongs/ sngar nas phyag chen gsan pa nas zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin skyong bde bar yod cig zhi gnas kyi ngang gdangs ltar langs pa'i/ lha sgom pa sngags bza ba ting nge 'dzin gyi spro bsdu la rtse gcig pas/ za nyal bshang ba gsum min pa tha mal par ye ma bzhugs/ ma bzhugs kyi na cho 'phrul je che je cher song*/ grogs rnams dang yang gcig bshan gcig la phog bas lhongs 'di byung 'di ma byung bya ba med pa byung*/

drung rim pa gnyis/ drung shāka pa gsum sku mtshams dang dor rtogs pa'i phu thag chod kyang gshegs/ rab 'byams gzhon pa cung zad smyo nas rjes byin gyis rlabs pas mdo la mnal du phebs/ phyis thog dngos su phog kyang gnod ma nus pa'i rtogs ldan chen po zhig byung*/ nyid kyis sku mtshams seng seng ye ma mdzad pa lo gsum pa'i mthar bar chad rang sar zhi/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su gzigs pa/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pas mun pa la nyi ma shar ba bzhin kun rmongs gar song med par brlag dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ phyag rdor/ ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral/ las kyi mgon po dang bcas pa gang 'dod du gzigs pa de nas byung ba sku mtshams grol nas rje'i spyan sngar byon/ phyis kyang smin thog tu zla ba drug /'phying ru'i dben gnas bde chen chos 'khor du lo gcig /gyer skyid dgon du lo gcig /byar tshin du dgun thog gcig /tsa rir lo lnga dang*/ gzhan lo re la zla ba re gsung ngag shin tu dam pa mdzad/ thugs dam rgyun chags kyi rim pa la/ bla ma sgrub pa phyi nang gsang gsum/ rten 'brel gi nyams len/ bde mchog gi bsnyen pa khri tsho re/ dgongs kha chos skyongs rnams kyi gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang*/ ye shes mgon po'i bsnyen pa khri phrag re/ srod la phyag rdor gyi bsnyen pa khri phrag re rnams chag med/ rje 'brug pa (9na17)rin po che la gang gsan pa nas da lta tshun chag med yin/ de dag legs par brtsis pa ji tsam song ba'i grangs ni/ bla ma sgrub pa nang sgrub dang gsang sgrub gnyis la bye ba gnyis/ sa ya bdun/ 'bum tsho drug /stong phrag gtas/ bde mchog la bsnyen pa/ dung 'phyur gcig /bye ba lnga/ sa ya lnga/ 'bum tsho drug /khri tsho gnyis/ phyag rdor la/ dur 'phyur gcig /bye pa bzhi/ sa ya drug /'bum tsho drug /khra phrag gsum/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i bsnyen pa/ dung 'phyur gdeg

/sa ya gcig /'bum phrag dgu/ khri tsho bdun/ rkang pa brgyad la khri tsho lnga/ stong tsho bzhi/ shā san la khri tsho lnga/ dud sol ma'i bsnyen pa sa ya gsum/ cho bsnyen bye ba gcig /sa ya bdun/ 'bum tsho gsum/ khri tsho bzhi rnams so// des na gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang nus mthu gnyis su med do// byar tshin du bzhugs dus chos bcu zhig gi tho rangs slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas/ lha lcam manda ra dang ye shes mtsho rgyal mdzes pa mtshungs pa med pas mtha' brten mdzad pa mngon sum du byon nas byin gyis brlabs te 'chi med da cho'i dngos grub stsal/ tsa ri tra'i mtsho zhal sogs sngon gyi grub pa rnams la byung ba dang mthun pa 'ga' byung gsung ba la 'dir 'di zhes mi gsung*/ sku 'khor bas kyang mthong bar pho brang khar rje dpon slob bzhugs pa la/ mtsho skad cig gis phur bur khol nas mdun gyi ri de'u de non la khad pa tsam byung*/ gzhan zhing skyong*/ rdo rje g.yu sgron/ gzhi bdag las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas bka' 'khor na sgor re las bgyi ba'i dgug don du bzhugs pa dang*/ yang rtser gza' mchog dngul nyid dang*/ nyid kyi sku zhar chos rje slob dpon pa gnyis kas mthun par snang ba dang*/ dbus su rgyal po be ha ra 'khor bcas/ gung thang du lha mo re ma ti dang*/ zhang gi chos bsrung*/ mkhar chur snyong kha/ dur khrod bdag mo/ bkra shis mthong smon dang lha sar dpal lha mi sgrib par gzigs (9ba18)ba dang g.yar dam len pa/ gzhan yang ra lung la sogs pa'i gnas bdag thams cad dka' la nyan pas phran tshogs kyi bya ba gzhan la bsdigs mo'am/ rkun ma rtsad gcod lta bu sogs la bka' bsgo mdzad tsam la rtags thon pa byang phun tshogs rab brtan du/ sku chas rku la shor ba rku mkhan khams pa zhig red pas zam chu chud du la brul te shi ba dang*/ sgo mtha' rdzong pas phyag g.yog pa 'ga' shes bzhin du brdungs pas de dag gi pha yul ne la bshongs chung khyer bas 'gyod pa rtas mi zin pa byung*/

'khyong rgyas ma dre'u brlag pa la gshan dmar la bsngags pas dre'u'i sgal pa la me mched pas dngangs te slar phul ba sogs mang*/ cig car gnas nang du jo bzang gsod mi rkyen sum pa ba cig gis ston mchod kyi tshe bshags pa bsgrubs kyang pha bu gsum lam du shar re 'gro ba'i dkyil nas gsor mi rang gtor ba lor ma rnyed/ lo gcig song ba na gzhi bdag gi sku mkhar rtsa na ro gnyis 'dug zer gnas nang na yod pa mang pos ltar phyin pas de'i 'khyil chu'i dbus na ro de la des/ mis shing btang ba na des la gangs 'dzin du byung*/ nyin mo yin kyang kun dred pa/ lcang gling pa rol pa'i rdo rjes mdung gi rtser gri btags te phog par rgyab pas mtsho da khrag gis dmar chil ba zhig byas nya bkyal ba byung*/ 'di rdor 'dzin du bzhugs pa nas gzhi bdag gi dngos brgyud kyi cho 'phrul ha 'gal bas/ mthu rtsal la mtshungs par med par brtsi ba 'di byung ba yin/ lhag par gshan dmar gyis ci gsung sgrub pas de rang la thugs rtsis che ste/ 'phyong rgyas nas sde pa hor bsod pa'i drung rtse thang nas 'phyong rgyas su phebs pa la lam du dgug mkhan mang bas ci drag gleng skabs/ nged kyis gshan dmar la phyag g.yog zhu bcug pas nyes pa mi yong gsung*/ de la gser gtor phul smod byang rgyas par mdzad/ de ka la thugs bkal te phebs pas mtshan 'gros kyi ring mo dmar phur de ba chibs gnod du 'gro (10na19)ba dang*/ nyin rlung dmar 'tshub 'khyil le ba sngon du 'gro ba 'phyong rgyas su ma phebs ring byung bas lhag par thugs ches skad/ de dag dper brjod tsam ste thams cad bris na 'bum tsam mo// dang po rjes ded 'bod du gnang*/ ded rnams bya yul nas rim pas yar 'brog tu sleb/ chos rdzong pa'i bsu ba 'dug pa'i steng du nam mkhar 'ja'i gung khang khyab zhig 'dug pa kun gyis mthong 'dis de'i nang du dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa gtso 'khor khra phung nge ba gzigs pa bzhin ra lung du sleb/

re ma ti babs pa'i ngag la yang nged gtso 'khor bsu ba la 'ongs pa khyod kyis mthong song zer bas/ gsung ba la yid ches/ gzhan yang rje gshegs nas gdung chog 'dzin pa'i skabs su/ sku gdung rin po che'i drung du bdag brtag pa gnyis pa kha ton byed/ 'di pa bskang gso mdzad kyi yod pa zhig gi mod la dngangs had de yug cig lus song*/ bdag la'ang zil chen po cig byung dus ci yin na dris pas/ bya rog gdong gis btsun pa'i mgo khrag thig thig 'bab pa rlangs phyur re ba zhig bzhag song*/ mgo bo de ka thog pa chos rje rnam grol bzang po'i dbu 'dra ba zhig 'dug /nged kyis mjal myong ba yin gzhan la 'phros ma btang gsung*/ de nas zla ba gcig ma lon par de gshegs par snang ngo*// de yang ka thog pa dang bsgrub sde pa lho phyogs sus la zlos pa/ khong rang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dge bshes/ 'khor du rnying ma ba'i sngags 'chang bzang po rkyang gis bskor ba'i mthu can zhig red pas ra lung phyogs su las sbyor mang po brtsams pa/ rje'i byin rlabs kyis gnod pa ci yang ma byung*/ rje gshegs nas nas nged rang gis sku rim la 'bungs pas gnod ma nus pa'i khar phyir log par go gzhan las sbyor ched dmigs ci yang ma byas gsung ngo*// gzhan tsa ri trar rdol zhabs kyi padmo dang skyid shod du spyan drangs ba'i tshe byang khar 'brongs phu zhes pa bla ma zhang gi (10ba20)bsgrub gnas gzigs par byon bsnyel gsos te bzhengs dus phyag rdo la btsugs sar phyag rjes gsal por byung ba gsang bar mdzad bzhed kyang phal cher gyis mthong bas de sub ma nus/ tswa ri'i de sbas so// gzhan dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i dus bdud rtsi dang bum chu khol zhing lud pa/ gtor tshogs mi rnying pa sogs ngo mtshar ni brjod kyis mi lang ba byung ngo*// thos don bsam pas 'dris par byas pa gang*/ sgom pa goms pa bshad bzhin 'byung gzigs nas/

gang gis sgrub la nan tan brtson byas pa'i/ mtshungs pa gangs can 'di na mi la ka /'phags pa'i spyan gyis mi gzigs dag pa'i gzugs/ gang yang med mod cha tsam gzigs gsung ba/ blo dman byis pa mgu ba'i phyir yin zhes/ de nyid gzigs pa'i rgyus yod pa rnams gleng*/ phal cher bla ma'i gdams ngag snyan gong brgyan/ yud tsam re la nogs par byed pas na/ snying glegs yon tan bris kyis 'phongs mthong bas/ phyi ma'i thar 'dod khyod kyi rnam thar slob/ rje bla mas 'di thag lo'i gzhug la bdag gi slob dpon du bsko bar mdzad pa'i byi lo hor zla dang po'i nyer lnga la rje cung zad sku grib kyis nyog pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i mthun pa'i gtso bor bzhugs/ gnam gang gi dgongs ja thon rjes gtor kha gsos pas/ su yin 'od lhag lhag de ci yin gsung*/ bdag lags/ thugs dam gtor kha gso ba yin zhus pas/ chos mgon pa yin 'dug pa/ khyod kyis sprul sku rin po che'i phyag g.yog mthil phyin pa zhig gis gsung gdams pa'i mod la rje dgongs pa thim/ de ma thag sa g.yo ba chen po zhig byung*/ rje'i gsung des bdag lo bcu gsum nas nyer gnyis kyi bar bcar bzhugs mdzad gtso bor bsrung 'khor/ de nas 'brug lugs kyi chos bka' rnams la rmo mo slob mdzad khyad par bdag la brtse ba'i spyan ras g.yel ba med par sbyong mkhan bya bkra shis rnam rgyal ni grongs/ gong sa bstan 'dzin nor bus ni (11na21)ra lung par phar phul mkho ba ma stabs/ ra lung nas rje rgyal tshab dam pa rang gi phal cher ni spyan 'bras kyi mthong tsam mdzad kyang zhu kha yang nas sku 'khris pa rnams kyis bya par phul/ gnyis bar gsum shor gyi dpes shin tu bya bas btang ba'i ring*/ 'dis tha na gnyer tshun khur dka' ba mdzad pas mi gcig la drin che/ phyis dgung lo bdun cu brgal ba tsam la/ yang rtser spyan drangs zhabs kyi padmo la btud de/ tshe dbang*/ phyag rdor/

mgon po/ gzhi chos sogs 'brug bskor rje'i zhal sngar po sti lung dbang tsam las ma thob pa kun zhus/ de yang rje nyid kyis phyag 'bul ba dang*/ gdan mnyam mnyam gang na mi yod/ nged rang gis yang rje ras chung pas rje btsun la skyes su phul ba lta bur 'bul ba yin ces bka' rgya gdams pas/ phebs bsu phyag bzhugs gdan ches mtho ba'i mthong bkur zhu ma btub pa ma gtogs bdag khengs nas mi zhu ba min no// de yang bdag gi lo nyer gnyis pa/ 'di nyid rang zhe brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe/ dpal tsa ri tra/ de'i nang gi rtsa mchog gam rtsa gong ngam rtsa re zhes bzhag pa dang*/ gshin rje'i 'du khang du gnas yig rnams su bsgrags pa/ nyams rtogs cig tu 'char ba'i gnas yin pas cig car dpal gyi nags ljongs/ slob dpon chen po padmas ma 'ongs pa na skyes bu mkha' la sgra sgrogs pas gzung ste dge 'dun gyi kun dga' rab 'byung bar lung bstan pa/ de yang ma chen rdza khrod shar nas rten 'brel gyi dbang gis 'brug pa'i las tshan bsdus/ de skabs kong kha stod 'dir ni phal cher mi ngas kyis lnga par gyur pas rkyen pa rgyal po stag rdo rje stsal du bton/ ldir tsho brgyad 'or shod dang bcas pa'i mi sna drag pa kun khrid/ rje spos skya pa la gsol ba btab/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnas nang gi rig pa'i mgon/ 'gran ras kyi dbon chos sku bde ba chen po dpon slob gnas phyi'i yon (11ba22)bdag gi mchod gnas su brdzangs te ri pa la nas chu 'bab bcu gsum pa la/ da la khye'u khrag mdog sha'i ral pa can zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu'i nu bos phul ba'i gnas gsing ma g.yu'i maṇḍal gsum brtsegs pa 'dra ba'i steng la thob ces lung bstan pa bzhin/ 'gro mgon des gnas sgo phye ste gzung*/ de nas rgyun ring bas ri pa mchod pa sogs kyi rnam g.yeng gi dbang du gyur pas sgrub tshugs zhan nas/ rgyal dbang rje phebs skabs jo bzang btsugs/

bzhi bcu tsam gyi rgyags gnang*/ rdor 'dzin 'gran ras kyi dpon brgyud chos rgyal rin chen bkod/ de nas rdor 'dzin gyi srol gtod/ de rjes rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa rin chen/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan pa rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'dzin pa thal du rin po che/ rdo rje 'dzin pa ḍa ki ras chen drug song*/ bdun par bdag kong po nas yar dbus gtsang du 'gro zhor/ rkyen snang rgyal po'i grong khyer du tsā ri pa'i ri jo bzang*/ yon bdag mi sna dang bcas 'dzom pa byas te/ rdo rje g.yu sgron mas/ gnas 'di rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal du yod/ de'i dbang gis 'di la bar chad chen po cig yod/ de la da lam rdor 'dzin 'di 'os gzhan gyis yong ba med ces lung bstan pa ltar bskos pa'i nyin chos rje rdor 'dzin chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos pa'i sgar pa drag zhan thams cad kyis phyag 'bul ba sogs mdzad pas 'phrin las kyi rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ de res dbus gtsang tshun ded dad lhan du byon te/ phyir tsā ri trar byon/ kong po kha stod la 'bul sdud rgyas pa mdzad/ 'or shod nas dpon 'brug rgyal po pha bus lhag par zhabs tog che/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi phyag len la bstan te bzhugs ring*/ sgrub pa ba rnams la bar bar du bka' chos blo dang mtshams par gnang*/ gzhan thugs dam 'phel bar byung ngo*// de ltar lo gsum tshun thugs so mi sod pa med la/ phag lo phrag yul srung (12na23)rir 'brug pa'i dgon gsar/ kar srid pas bshig /lho brgyud pa'i 'brug pas jo bzang ma byas par de'i len por/ rje mi bskyod rdo rje'i mdzo mangs phyags/ de'i lan du dgongs/ tsā ri pa dpon slob gang la'ang the rag med cing lung stongs su sems can gyi bde skyid sgrub par bsdad pa la/ nang so sku rab pas tsā ri bar zhabs tog byed sa med pa'i nag yig bkram/

der sku rab tu byon nas rgyu mtshan mtha' seng phul bar mi chen rdzu'i rang bzhin mi mdzad par gsung rigs thon rtsib 'dra zhig 'dug pa dang*/ gnas bsrung gis 'byon par bskul nas/ bya yul du zhu ngo spron par byon/ mi'i dbang po mched kyang*/ nyid 'khrungs sa mnga' zhabs par song*/ zhus pa la ched gnyer ma mdzad/ de'i ring la sku rab nas phug bzhugs kyi gdan sa spang chen gser 'bru skyo go bas sregs/ der ri jo bzang rnams kyis ma chags par tshur 'ong lam skyo sgo ba'i ltes bo byed mkhan de khong tsho dang gdong thug tu byung nas gron/ de dag gis yul stod kyi spang mo bsregs/ bya yul du 'byor/ skye sgo bas de lan la spang chen gzims khang sogs bsregs pas tshabs che bar gyur/ rang la le lan med kyang so so'i bstan pa'i sku chags su 'dug pas bcos ma bde/ de'i tshe bsrung ma bskul ba'i dus la bab par bsam/ lo ro grong stod mkhar nas dmod pa dang bcas gtor chen 'phangs pa/ me dpung dngos su dwags phyogs su rgyug pa byung*/ de nas gtsang nas gdan 'dren pa dang bstun rgyal byed tshal tshun byon grwa rigs der bzhag /sde srid rin po che gong dkar nas kyi sku bsrung du pho nya bas spyan drangs te/ gzhi kha gong dkar du phebs/ dpon sa bdag mo dung dkar mas de kha nas bka' chos gsan/ sde srid zhabs drung rang nas bskur mthong shin tu che ba mdzad/ chu bo rir gtan bzhugs dgos pa'i zhu nan/ ze bo bzhugs yul du phul ba re zhig bzhes/ de nas ring por ma lon par/ (12ba24)'phyong rgyas stag rtse nas khri lcam don yod sgrol ma sku skye dma' ba la mkhyen rab sku bsod de las che ba mi srid pa des spyan drangs/ bla mar khur gdang po che brtsis phul/ gong dkar nas zhabs drung sne'u gdong rtse'i khrir phebs pa'i skabs su der byon/ sbe srid kyi gor bzhugs pas drag po'i las sbyor 'khor lo mnan gtad sbyin sreg sogs mdzad pa'i skabs ma byung yang bsam gtan gyi stobs dang*/

bsrung ma dang sde brgyad bkol nus pa'i dbang gis mtshan ma bzang bar byung*/ de lo rku rab pa gar stod du byon pas/ byings kyis mthu mi bden pa lta bur gleng yang*/ dkon mchog gis bslu ba med snyam rtse gcig pa'i gsol ba btab/ rku rab tu ltas mi dge ba mang po mang po byung*/ de kha'i dgun nas brtsams te rku rab pa'i dmag kong por brtsams tshad bug /ltag par glang lo chos rgyal pho brang du dmag bug tshabs che ba'i khar rid 'phrang du kong pos sbub/ stong sgyer gyi bar kong po la shor/ yang dag sa stod du sde 'dus bsgrigs dgas stod tshang ma shor ba sogs kyis/ rje padma dkar po bkra shis mthong smon du bzhugs par/ sde pa kun dga' pa rang byon/ bya ba yab yum byis zhu ngo mdzad/ tsā ri spang mo yang cham pa khong ras bzos/ tsā ri mched pa'ang 'phro brdungs kyis nyam thag nas tshod zin par gyur te da lta'i bar du bde bar gyur pa yin no// de nas tsā ri tshags su bcug tsā rir byon yun 'gar bzhugs bka' bcu pa stag dang phyis res 'phen ram pa sogs sgrub pa ba rnams dang*/ 'phyong rgyas nas sde pa chos rje'i drung*/ g.ya' bzang chos mdzad gzhon pa sogs chos dbang gis re ba gang bar byas/ cig car bden sa gra 'grig shugs che la gnas zin par song bas thams cad kyis sgrog rus pa chag pas gyang du songs zhes bsngags so// rkyen de lta bu la bsrung ma bskul ba'i nus pa can 'di lta bur med na gnas skor tshud pa dka' bar mthong bas sngon a lce'i lung bstan la'ang yid ches so// rdor 'dzin (13na25)mdzad bzhin par bya yul du byon dus mi'i dbang po mtsho skyes rdo rjes gsung chos gsan bzhed de snyan du phul bar de 'dra mi yong gsung*/ phyag g.yog pa rnams kyis gnang dgos tshul phul bar/ spyir sde pa 'di kun skangs rin po che lta bu la 'ang g.yog mtho gis brnyas bcos mdzad par snang*/

dger sgang nged rang gi sku mched 'di gnyis sku na phra ba nas brtsams te zhabs tog la 'bungs pa cig yin te/ nged rang tsā ri nas yul thon pa'i dus legs po gtan ma mdzad/ sdug dus su thugs rjes 'dzin mkhan gong dkar nas sde srid rin po che sras yum/ 'phyong rgyas nas yum drung rang yin gsung sde par chos yem phul/ don dam tshig la sel zhugs dogs pa 'dug /gnas skabs bya par skyon pa 'dra yang phugs gzigs pas thugs brtser gda'o// de nas dbus su phebs nas/ yum gyi bkas bskul nas sde pa hor bsod pa'i drung gis kyang gter mgon gyi dbang gsan zil gzhan dang mi 'dra ba byung*/ bshibs skyin thugs dang 'khrungs/ phyis sde pa'i bka' las bla ma'i drung la a ma drung pas gsung chos gsan/ ded la zhus rang gsung ba 'di bya ba'i zhen rus yin bsam pa shar nas yun ring por ma zhus/ phyis bka' bzhin zhus/ don la bcar na bla ma 'di dang sprad pa gcig bu'i bka' drin yang khur mi tshugs pa 'dug gsung shin tu gus/ de'i stobs kyis rgyal bu lcam srid kun gyi rtsa ba'i bla mar 'khur/ karma pa rnams rje mi bskyod rdo rje 'dis mthus dkrongs de'i dbang gis 'brug pa'i mthu ba rgya bo zer gnag gnag rang byed pa zhig 'dug ste/ 'di ni skyes bu dam pa su yang mnan bsreg bsad dbye sogs kyi yul min gal te las sbyor de dag gi mtshan dang na bza' la sogs pa'i dum bu shor na dgos pa'i las bul med du gtong ba yin ces nyid lta ci gzhan la gdom na skyon gar chags/ de skad zer ba'i rgyu yang*/ rje de mtsho dkar du phebs pa'i dus bud med bzang mo zhig (13ba26)dang*/ ban ma hor lta bu gnyis kyis ja thod brgal zhig zhu ba thab tu skyar bas khrag tu song*/ de gnyis gar yang ma snang*/ de nas bsnyun gzhis dpon slob gron chad mang*/ de'i rkyen gyis rje yang gshegs par 'dug /de ni gnas bsrung gi cho 'phrul du ni kun rtsi snang*/

las kyi sbyor ba mkhan gyi byas par mi 'dug /de bzhin gro bo lung nas chos rje dpa' bo'i drung kong por phebs pa'i tshe sgar pa drag pa mang po shi/ rje rang la'ang 'od mi thang bar bsnyun mdze thu ba zhig byung byas pa'i dus su'ang*/ 'brug pa'i mthu ba rgya bos gtang dang du brlung zhon btang ba yin zer/ de yang de nyid kyi sras mkhar la sogs pa'i sa gnyan sar mkhar las dang*/ bshad sgrub gling gi rten chen la rgya 'dre gdug pa can zhugs 'dug pa bton pa yin gsung zhal tsho mdzad 'dug ba de dag gi skyon 'dra yi/ 'dis ni de dag la mthu byed pa'i rgyu yang mi snang ngo*// gang na'ang 'di la smad pa'i lugs su byas de skad bsgrags pa'o// brtags na rang gi bla ma de dag nus mthu gzhan las chung ba/ lha dang lhar ma mnyam/ mi dang mir ma mnyam pa 'dra zhig 'dug pas blun po'i smad pa bstod ra'i dpe gtsang ma'o// zing po brtul mis rje padma dkar po la brnyas te ru pa phyags/ ja sgrub pa brdungs byas dus/ bla ma'i sku dgra de khar bzhag pas mi 'thus dgongs drag po gtor zer ro tsam mdzad pas/ yul der rlung dmar chen po 'tshubs shing*/ nyi ma dgung la mun rub/ yul de'i shing sdong mang po 'gyel/ khang pa'i pu shu nang du lhung pa so las byung*/ g.yu 'brug kho rang liṅga'i dbyibs su song nas myur du shi/ shul mi nang 'dzings/ mthu grags kong lud par mi shong ba byung*/ mi thams da ban btsun la ma bdo zer nas mthong cher reng pas bstan pa spyi'i zhabs tog tu song ngo*// gzhan yang rin spungs pa dpon zhang la rje padma dkar po sku drin can yin kyang drin lan log 'jal du/ rgyal byed (14na27)tshal thor zhig dang*/ dpon slob phyogs gtogs la tsa ra brda 'ded byed rgyu ba zhig 'dug par/ bkra shis mthong smon du bzhugs skabs lcang gling pa dang*/ sngags grwa slob dpon kun snying sogs kyis gsol nas chos skyong rbad pa'i 'go btsugs/

rin spungs su ltas ngan pa mang du byung snang ste non ches pas shod pa 'gags/ sku gshed yod ring la brkyang bskum ma mdzad pas slar lha rtse nas bsgrubs pa'i gtor ma chen po dang khyab mjug gi gdong zor nyi zhur gyi dus 'phangs pa der khrom thams cad kyis mngon sum la gtor ma gnyis las me 'thon sgra dang bcas je cher song nas gtsang phyogs rgyugs pa byung*/ rin spungs su mthu rtags byung tshul kyang snga ma ni zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du gzhis khar gtso phog /sprin rā hu la'i gzugs su snang ba shar nas 'ongs te 'brug glogs ser ba tshad med babs/ byams chen po ta la sdib/ de nas brtsams te gtor ma skam po thog tu babs pa/ gnam rdo lhung ba sogs dang*/ khyad par gtso babs pas bla shing dang rin spungs mtsho lha'i lha tho bsregs/ gzhi kha rang gi sgrol ma lha gtso'i mes bsregs pa sogs rtags bsam gyis mi khyab/ rtags de byung ba'i nus pa kho rang dpon blon 'khrugs gtsang shor/ gzhis kha rin spungs su de snga dgra'i dmag mthong ma myong ba la kod pa tshong pas dngas bstod byas te skor rgyag tsha grul can byas/ da lta lhag med du ma gyur tsam mo// sku bsrung pa sngags pa rdo rje zer ba zhig gis 'brug pa'i mthu bzlog 'dra ngas khag theg zer kha tsho bton pa la tshig de bstan pa spyir brnyas pas ched kyis gzir bas/ de nyid kyis gtor ma 'phangs pa log ltas 'gyur/ nad shin tu pa pos mnar te skad ngan 'don bzhin par shi bar 'dug /gzhan sde srid de pa phya gral grwa sa grangs mang*/ sku rim bzang*/ yang thugs bsnubs pa sogs sngags 'chang bzang la mang bas mthu chen min pas glags rnyed pa'ang dka'/ rin spungs (14ba28)pa'i ming ma gtogs de'i nang tshan 'ga' la mthu byung na g.yeng mi thon de rang la gzir dgos/ babs na chos pa yin pas mthar mi skyel lo gsung*/ sngon gyi rwa los kyang mthu rtags 'di tsam bton pa'i skad mi snang ngo*// gzhan yang bya yul du bsam pa ngan pas kun nas blangs te sbyor ba ngan pa byed pa rnams la mgo bor gnam lcags 'bab 'go tshugs/

des na rje gong mas 'di sngags 'chang du bkod pa ni sku skyes phyi ma la zhabs tog rlabs po cher dgongs par gda'o// shun du dpon sa bdag mo'i drung dang*/ skyid shod nas dpon sa stag lung nas spyan drangs bka' chos kyis thugs kyi re ba gang*/ tshal pa'i dge 'dun la chos kyi sbyin pa bkye/ stag lung khri rin po che'i bla mar gdan 'dren byung kyang phebs ma thub lhag par gong dkar du byon/ sde srid rin po che/ yum drung*/ rgya ri nas dpon sa/ gdung brgyud rin po che sku mched dang bcas par 'brug lugs thel lugs kyi chos bka' mtha' yas pa phul/ gzhan yang gser thog nas mchen/ mngon dga' dbon po sogs 'brug pa'i grwa ris chos 'chad rnams dang*/ dpal kun bzang rtse ba yab sras sogs rtse'i dkon gnyer dpon rnams dang*/ sde pa shag pa lha thongs pa zhal ngo sogs drung skor/ ra ba smad pa'i slob dpon pa'i drung dang dge 'dun sogs chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ thangs gsum bzhi tsam phebs/ ra lung du dbon rin po cher sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs phul/ yum che chung gnyis/ sras dang bcas pa'i bla mar bskur/ dbon rin po che rang la 'brug skor gyi phyag bzhes gal che tshad gnang ngo*// de dus pa snam du rje padma dkar pos shog phebs pa ltar 'byon zhor rgyang mkhar rtser yum drung mnga' bdag rgyal mo/ sde pa rnam par rgyal ba/ dpon sa byang nas sogs la dbang legs par phul/ sde pa ma nas bzhugs gdan mnyam mnyam ja sna gtod pa sogs bkur mthong che bar byung*/ blo bde rtse chen nas zhabs tog /'brong rtser sde pa sku skyer chos (15na29)dbang*/ pa snam du rje'i phyag phyir mtshan nyid grwa tshang gnyis sngags grwa co grwa dang bcas bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun brgya tsam gyis bsu ba gser sbreng dang bcas 'dug /phebs nas gcung rin po che'i sprul sku/ las bstod byang nas rje btsun drung*/ chos sde dga' gdod mkhan po chos rje rab brtan pa/

sngags grwa slob dpon ngag dbang blo gros/ mtshan nyid slob dpon shed legs pa/ cog grwa bla ma bka' bcu pa dbang phyug dpal ldan/ de ba'i khrod na phug nas rin chen dpal bzang*/ grong nag sa mdzad sogs mdo sngags la mkhyen pa can mang du bzhugs pa rnams kyis gtsos dge 'dun bdun brgya tsam la chos skyong gi rjes gnang sogs 'dod chos kyis re ba bskang*/ rje bya yul du thegs nas rgyal byed tshal du rgyun rkyad pa bzhugs/ rim gyis gong dkar zhabs drung 'byor/ de dus rgyal nas thams cad mkhyen pa der phebs pa dang mjal/ bka' las chos skyong gi skor la dogs gcod zhu dgos yong gsung ba/ drung pa lha btsun pas phyag 'bul la byon chos skyong skor gsan rgyu'i snyan gsan phul byung*/ 'phyong rgya sogs su phebs/ gzhan yang sde ba drung gi spyan drangs/ sde pa sku mched/ me rag mdo nas chos rje sku skye sogs lho brag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ lam du sde pa yugs nas rlung jo yes kyi dbon tshang mkhyen pa yangs pa chos pa rab gcig dang mnyam gsung shin dgyes/ snga phyir gzhi kha gri gur phebs pa'i sbyin bdag snga ma sde pa dpal ldan bkra shis kyi gnas bcu/ nyid kyi sku brnyan rnams kyi rab gnas gsung chos gsan yun yang ring bar bzhugs/ phyis sde pa nor bu'i drung yab sras kyis gus pa gzhan dang rim 'dra mdzad phyag tu ci dgos thams cad de nas 'bul bas/ bka' las nged rang la zang zing gi nor dgos tshad blangs chog pa sde pa rin po che gri gu nas yin/ de dag gi sku rim ma byas na mi yong phebs rgyun brtan gyi bsrung 'khor/ chos skyong la (15ba30)legs pa'i mdongs sol mdzad snang*/ sde pa chos rje blo gros pad dkar ba la thugs rab che bas nged rang gi slob ma drag shos rang du yod/ da sde pas gzhi kha'i 'khur 'di bzhes pa tsā ri lta bu'i bla ma zhig mdzad na gsung*/ nged rang la khong sku mched pas zhabs tog myur ba med ces yang yang gsung*/

gzhan yang sde pa ka bzhi pa'i chos mdzad la yang thugs zhi dul che gsung mnyes mnyes mdzad gdam ngag kyang legs par gnang*/ phyis tsā ri gdan sa bsko bzhag gi 'os kyang khong gnyis dad lcang gling rol pa'i rdo rje la mdzad/ gzhan chos rje kun dga' legs pa'i sku tsha/ ratna gling pa'i dbon rin chen rgyan mchog /dar lung sku skyes sogs thams cad la thugs rtsis che/ de ltar tsā rir lo nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam rdor 'dzin du bzhugs de'i ring la chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras kyi sku mi tshad las che ba gser zangs kyis bzhengs/ de la chos rdzas/ dkar me'i 'bri gnag ltos che ba sbyar/ de dus rkyen nas nang so phyag mdzod pa sogs yon bdag ltos che ba tshogs tshur 'bul ba/ phar bka' dbang rab ston sogs mi 'gu lha 'gu mdzad/ de nas rje dbus su bzhugs pa'i seng la gzhi pa chang gis myos bca' ga ma byas pas gzims khang mes tshig kyang 'phrin las che bas sngar las ches bzang ba'i rten mchod thab chas gdan cha sogs lhag pa der bskyal/ zhig gsos kyang sngar bas legs pa bzos/ de nas thogs shig bzhugs te gnas 'di gyong bas rgas nas rang sdod pa'i yul du mi 'dug gsung dgongs kyang de ltar dgongs nas rje padma dkar po dang bka' bgros/ lcang gling pa gdan sar bkod/ 'bogs dang gnang sbyin che ba'i tshad mdzad/ rje rang bya yul nas dbus phyogs byon/ de rjes rje 'brug pa rin po che'i sku gser zangs las grub pa mi tshad lhag pa gcig sde pa gri gu nas chos rjes phyag g.yog zhal bkod/ bzo ba'i mi kho cha kun stabs rgyu rin po che rang gi phyag nas bsgrubs/ de dang byar du rta mgrin dang phyag rdor gyi lugs sku khru re ma bzos de yang (16na31)gnas kyi phag mo lha khang du bzhugs su bcug /de dag la yang mchod rdzas legs par gnang*/ mdor na 'phral gyi phyag rdzas la dad pa can gyis phul ba yin gsung bca' ga mdzad/ nor la snying po lan dgos pa yin gsung thams cad dge ba la gtong 'dzin chags ye mi mda'/

phral du sku 'khor ba la a tsi re la yang rtsad gcod dos drag mdzad/ gnas 'dzin dus sogs gnyer pa snga phyis nas khal lnga brgya drug brgya tsam khungs med du btang tshar ba gsan nas thabs med gsung cher mi skyon/ de yang mi gzhan mas ha che ba byed snang ste/ dgongs pa chung ngu la labs pas sku 'khris pa rnams kyis 'dzems nas rgyud chud mi za/ chen por song nas dkor gyis gzi ba yin blo lad nas srol du 'jug mi thug pas gyod mi brdal/ brdal kyang de dag la phyir 'dab rgyu med dgongs par 'dug pas mdzad pa shin tu legs par mthong*/ gzhan chos rgyal bya ba'i rgyal bu mched/ dpon sa rnam gsum gyis kyang bla mar 'khur gus btud phul du byung bar mdzad do// dgung lo bdun cu rtsa drug tsam la sku tshe'i bar chad gzigs/ da tshe mthar phyin des chog gsung ba dang*/ lhag par bkra shis mthong smon du 'bogs kong pas byed lugs rigs mi mthun par byas pas thugs skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur du 'dug pas/ bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa rnams kyis mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i gsol ba 'debs par sngags grwa slob dpon ngag dbang kun dga' snying po brdzangs pas gsol ba thebs te rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pas lo shas tshel bar chad mi 'byung ba'i lung bstan thob gsung ba ltar don la gnas pa 'di'o// de ltar zhi ba'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas gzhan la byin gyis brlabs pas nad zhi/ gdon gyi gnod pa dang*/ smyo ba dang 'bog pa thams cad mod la zhi bar 'gyur ba dang*/ dbang gi 'phrin las kyis chen po thams cad dbang du 'dus/ gang bzhed pa (16ba32)'phral 'phra' yid la med par sku drung du 'ong ba dang*/ drag po'i 'phrin las sngags chung 'khor lo rdzas la skyabs mthu ltas kyi dgug dod pa rnams dang mi 'dra bar/ gang la sdigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrol ba dang*/ de yang de dag ngan 'gror gzhol ba'i lam 'gags nas thar par 'dren nus pa yin no// rgyas pa'i 'phrin las ni/

chos kyi 'phrin las chos dar ba sngar bsnyad pa dang*/ bya yul du sku bsrung ba chen po tshe bdag bkra shis/ gling stod nas chen po nor bu rin chen slob dpon chen po rig 'dzin pa'am/ byar ston chos kyi dpal bzang*/ 'brug pa lo chen/ co grwa kun spangs/ sngags grwa bla ma kun snying*/ rdo rje gling gdan sa pa/ lha rtse gdan sa pa snga phyi/ gsal rje/ stag rtse ba'i bla ma/ yang rtse'i 'chad nyan gnyal rong paṇa chen sogs lho rgyud/ rje'i phyag phyir/ chos rje sku skye bsod nams tshul khrims bka' chos kyis tshim par mdzad de gnas su rdo rje 'dzin par bkod pa dang*/ rta sding nas dbon po/ ltag par las stong ri bo che nas grub chen rin po che thang stong pa'i dbon/ de nyid kyi sprul par padma dkar po'i mtshan lam du byung ba/ sna phu nas chos rje/ cog grwa gsar pa'i bla ma sogs che gnyan gyi 'dus pa la/ chos dang gdams ngag gang la gang 'os gnang bas dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa dbyar gyi mtsho lta bur nyin re las kyang nyin rer 'phel bar gyur pa dang*/ byang nas chos kyi rgyal po bkra shis stobs rgyas pas gdan 'dren byung kyang sku na smin pas 'byon ma thub/ gong dkar nas sde srid rin po che'i phyag tham/ 'phyong rgyas nas spyan 'dren yang yang byung kyang re zhig rje de padma dkar po'i sku'i rim 'gro bar bzhugs/ mang du brjod pas ci bya/ gang gi snyan grags srid pa'i ring khyab cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mor mdzad pa 'di'o// 'di skad ces/ gang gi zhabs skyes zhig na chen po'i (17na33)tshogs// ral pa'i rgyan la hab shar byed 'dug snyam// 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i me tog der 'bar ba// sngon byon dga' ba'i tshal la zhum pa sbyin// slob ma'i mtsho chen bcas pa'ang phal 'di la// byin rlabs yid bzhin nor bu mang mchis snyam// blo gsal skal bzang gdengs can khyod mdun du// legs bshad bsam 'phel zhu la bsam kyin dungs/

de ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa grub pa'i rol rtsed ces bya ba 'di sngags grwa slob dpon kun dga' snying po dang*/ rje nyid kyi zhal slob lha rtse gdan sa pa ngag dbang bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ dge slong dam pa padma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /chos sbyin rgya cher spel ba'i ched/ par bzhengs glegs bu re re la/ dngul krang yon 'gyed mdzad po ni/ chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan no/// /
